name: s2j-about-window
description: Using SwiftUI, reimplementing the AppKit-based "About Window".
author: Koutarou ISHIKAWA

scripts.lint:swift: npm run lint:swiftlint && npm run lint:swiftformat && npm run lint:periphery
scripts.lint:swiftlint: swiftlint lint --strict Sources Tests SampleApp.swift Package.swift
scripts.lint:build: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild build -project s2j-about-window.xcodeproj -scheme SampleApp -destination 'platform=macOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.analyze:swift: xcodegen generate && xcodebuild analyze -project s2j-about-window.xcodeproj -scheme SampleApp -destination 'platform=macOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
